generated.what_happened: Following an executive order by President Donald Trump directing federal agencies to replace the term 'Artificial Intelligence' with 'super intelligence' or 'SI,' Elon Musk announced that his company's AI arm, SpaceXAI, will be rebranded as SpaceXSI. Musk stated that the super intelligence moniker is better and declared that SpaceX is a super intelligence company, though no official timeline has been set and the company's online branding has not yet changed. The shift follows Trump's recent White House Accord on Super Intelligence, an agreement establishing voluntary safety guardrails signed alongside major tech leaders. In tandem with the naming directive, Trump also announced the formation of a federal Super Intelligence Force to coordinate government and industry efforts.
